web_sources.title: Cooperative game theory
web_sources.extract: In game theory, a cooperative or coalitional game is a game with groups of players who form binding "coalitions" with external enforcement of cooperative behavior. This is different from non-cooperative games in which there is either no possibility to forge alliances or all agreements need to be self-enforcing.
